name: css-blast-radius
description: See which pages your CSS edits affect as you type, compared with the live site.

commands.title: Show Which Changes (All, Uncommitted, This Session, Unsaved)

cssBlastRadius.server.description: Address of the shared local CSS Blast Radius server, setup page, and page comparison.

cssBlastRadius.autoStartServer.description: Start the server when a local connection is refused. The server keeps running after VS Code closes.

cssBlastRadius.serverPath.description: Path to the server CLI (packages/backend/dist/cli.js). Empty: the backend this extension was built from; the old daemonPath setting is a fallback.

cssBlastRadius.groups.description: Page group IDs linked to this project, saved in .vscode/settings.json. Only active linked groups count; use Link Page Groups to choose them.

enumDescriptions: Uncommitted: changes since your last commit, saved or not
Unsaved: typing you haven't saved yet
This session: changes since the window opened
All: every CSS change the live site doesn't have yet
cssBlastRadius.diffBase.description: The Blast Radius tab selected when a window opens: which of your CSS changes are counted. Switch tabs in the Blast Radius panel or with Show Which Changes.

cssBlastRadius.cursorCount.description: Show the affected page count next to the cursor while typing in a changed CSS rule.

cssBlastRadius.warnLostPages.description: Warn in Problems and next to the cursor when a removed rule or changed selector stops reaching at least this many pages.

cssBlastRadius.codeLens.description: Show page counts above CSS rules. Off by default because counts appear next to the cursor.

cssBlastRadius.nodePath.description: Node.js (≥ 20) used to start the shared server. Empty: “node” on PATH.

cssBlastRadius.daemonPath.description: Legacy fallback for serverPath. Prefer cssBlastRadius.serverPath.

scripts.package: tsc -p tsconfig.json && node scripts/stamp-server-path.cjs && vsce package --no-dependencies --allow-missing-repository --skip-license
